answer: Up to 20,000 events can arrive twice: offsets are flushed every 10 seconds at 2,000 changes/second, so a single crash resends up to 10 seconds of changes (10 x 2,000). The receiving side should remember, per key (order_id), the highest LSN applied, and skip any incoming event whose LSN is at or below it. Source: pa_pattern_cdc_dual_writes.md, L159-162 (redelivery) and L142 (LSN as log position).
